topic: Sloan windowed L2 Spherical Harmonics (SH) irradiance vs Gibbs negative ringing & antipodal rebound rig
topic_zh: Sloan 窗口化二阶球谐函数（L₂ SH）非负辐照度对比吉布斯负振铃与背面幽灵反光
scope: Deterministic Peter-Pike Sloan (2008) non-negative band-windowed L2 Spherical Harmonics irradiance (w1=0.75, w2=0.40) versus naive unwindowed Ramamoorthi-Hanrahan (2001) L2 truncation (w1=w2=1.0) and 9-basis trigonometric associated Legendre evaluation across 17 polar angles (theta in [10, 170] deg). No neural light-probe interpolation execution.

good_fit: Diffuse irradiance light probes, volumetric lightmaps, and sky-dome SH compression in Unity, Unreal Engine, and Frostbite
Explaining why unwindowed L₂ SH truncation dips negatively to −0.1563 at 120° and rebounds to +0.2238 at 170° under strong lights
Applying band weights (w₁=0.75, w₂=0.40) to factor the L₂ kernel into the non-negative complete square (3/16)I₀(1+μ)² ≥ 0
Evaluating 9-coefficient SH in Cartesian normal coordinates (nx, ny, nz) without spherical atan2/acos/sin calls
not_for: High-frequency mirror specular reflections requiring pre-filtered cubemap mipmaps or ray tracing
Sharp shadow boundaries requiring shadow maps or signed distance fields
Neural radiance caches (NRC) or learned light-probe interpolation networks
Unlit flat 2D UI elements without 3D surface normals
